# settings the plan changed. Use it only after the plan was done and the check was not fine.
# The unit has no rollback: each value is live as soon as its Enter is accepted, and leaving /N with
# ESC saves it. Keep the serial session open, and a second one for the check.
#
# Type this first, on lab-unit, and check the version:   /H
# The title must read "COMMAND MENU: Version 8.10": tacctl's tables are those of that command menu,
# and another version may number its pages differently: stop.
#
##### BACK-OUT, IP TABLES (the unit's list was empty): lab-unit #####
# The list held no entry at the pull. At /N, 5: for each slot from 1 to 20 type the slot number
# and Enter, then <SPACE><CR> to clear it. Then leave /N with ESC and wait for "Saving
# configuration to flash".
##### END OF IP TABLES: lab-unit #####
#
# A value that tacctl does not hold (a secret, a community) is a line that says to re-enter the one
# you keep.
# Check now: tacctl device config pull lab-unit --diff (the differences of the plan are back).
# Do not: paste anything outside the banners; paste a block into another unit; leave /N with ESC
# before the last step of the list.
# Locked out (the paste cut your session and no login works)? A superuser runs: tacctl breakglass hold lab-unit --reason "..."
# then log in on the unit's serial console as its local Administrator account,
# fix or back out, and the superuser runs: tacctl breakglass release lab-unit
